heroSubtitle: Terra Preta Organics develops soil amendments that restore soil function on degraded reclamation sites across Canada.

story.title: Our story
paragraphs: Terra Preta Organics was founded by Lee Martineau with a clear purpose: to restore soil function at scale. What began as a deep commitment to biologically active, regenerative soil systems evolved into a focused effort to address the realities of large-scale land disturbance.

Oil and gas, mining, and agriculture share common challenges. Compacted, stripped, and biologically depleted soils cannot recover through surface inputs alone. They require organic matter, functional biology, mineral balance, and structural rebuilding. Terra Preta was formed to meet that need.

Grounded in regenerative soil science, Terra Preta Organics develops high-performance biological soil amendments engineered for large-scale reclamation and agricultural systems. Our solutions are designed to rebuild soil structure, improve water retention, activate nutrient cycling, accelerate plant establishment, and support long-term land resilience.

From well sites and mine reclamation projects to broad-acre farmland, Terra Preta Organics exists to help land recover faster and function longer. We believe reclamation should move beyond compliance and toward the full restoration of living soil systems.

items.title: Manufacturing in Sundre, Alberta
items.description: Our facility in Sundre produces Terra Revive pellets using consistent formulations and quality-controlled processes. We maintain inventory to support Canada-wide delivery.

items.title: Quality assurance
items.description: Every batch is tested for moisture content, particle size, and ingredient consistency. We provide batch-specific QA documentation and maintain traceability for all shipments.

members.name: Lee Martineau
members.description: Lee Martineau is the Founder and CEO of Terra Preta Organics and a recognized leader in regenerative soil reclamation. He develops advanced, biology-driven pelletized amendments that restore soil function on disturbed landscapes, with a focus on rebuilding organic matter, activating nutrient cycling, and strengthening long-term ecosystem resilience. Working closely with environmental and energy sector partners, Lee brings a systems-based approach to reclamation that integrates soil biology, mineral balance, and practical field application to improve measurable site performance.

members.name: Stephanie Mondin
members.description: Stephanie is the Chief Administrative Officer of Terra Preta Organics, bringing more than 20 years of experience leading successful organizations and high-performing teams. She oversees operational leadership, financial stewardship, governance, and systems development, ensuring the company scales with discipline and clarity. With over a decade of entrepreneurship across multiple ventures, Stephanie builds organizations that balance resilience with purpose. A lifelong gardener turned entrepreneur, she believes growth begins with the soil, where strong roots create lasting possibility.

members.name: Timothy Wiens
members.description: Timothy Wiens serves as Operations Manager at Terra Preta, bringing a rare blend of mechanical expertise, systems thinking, and hands-on ingenuity to the team. Raised on an Alberta farm, he developed an early understanding of how complex systems work together and how to keep them running under real-world conditions. He built his own off-grid home just outside Sundre using materials from the land and designed and installed his own solar power system, reflecting both technical skill and practical self-reliance. A heavy duty mechanic by trade and a natural engineer in practice, Timothy excels at designing, optimizing, and implementing operational systems that are efficient, durable, and built to perform.

members.name: Perry Dixon
members.description: Perry Dixon is Terra Preta’s Operations Supervisor and has been with the company since its inception. He leads manufacturing execution and production support, ensuring equipment, processes, and output consistently meet strict performance standards. Raised on a farm near Brooks, Alberta, Perry combines a practical understanding of agricultural demands with deep technical command of the pellet manufacturing process, from blending and extrusion through final quality control. Known for his discipline, precision, and reliability under pressure, he is essential to maintaining production integrity and delivering consistent, field-ready product at scale.

members.name: Chris Kay
members.description: Chris was raised on a farm in Alberta, where he developed a deep respect for the demands and discipline of working with the land. Today, he brings a practical foundation to Terra Preta, guiding farmers, landowners, and reclamation teams in building soils that perform. Chris focuses on restoring biological function, strengthening nutrient systems, and improving resilience so properties become more productive and self sustaining year after year. Chris approaches every project with clarity, field experience, and a commitment to measurable results.
